shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗眼器和紧急喷淋旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an eyewash station and an emergency shower, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全设施与洗眼喷淋。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进实验室，环顾四周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a lab on his first day and looks around.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研问他：洗眼器在哪？阿杰一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student asks him a question; he looks around blankly.
shots.narration: 小研问：洗眼器在哪？他答不上来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 洗眼器前堆着纸箱
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station is blocked by stacked cardboard boxes.
shots.narration: 原来洗眼器前，还堆着纸箱。

shots.section_title: 安全设施能救命，快冲是关键
shots.scene: 防护再好，意外仍可能发生的示意：液滴越过防护
shots.prompt_en: A droplet slips past protective gear despite precautions. No faces.
shots.narration: 防护再周全，意外也可能发生。
overlay: 安全设施能救命，快冲是关键

shots.section_title: 安全设施能救命，快冲是关键
shots.scene: 计时图标：越早冲洗，伤害越小
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon beside an eye icon: the sooner the rinse, the smaller the injury. No people.
shots.narration: 越快冲洗，伤害越轻。

shots.section_title: 安全设施能救命，快冲是关键
shots.scene: 洗眼器、喷淋和通风柜并排，都是基本设施
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station, an emergency shower and a fume hood side by side as basic equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 它们和通风柜一样，是基本设施。

shots.section_title: 安全设施能救命，快冲是关键
shots.scene: 四个图标：位置、通道、会冲、就医
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a location pin, a clear path, a rinsing eye and a hospital. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 记牢四件事：位置、通道、会冲、就医。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 实验室平面图上标出各类安全设施
shots.prompt_en: A lab floor plan with icons for an eyewash station, a shower, extinguishers, a first aid kit and exits. No text.
shots.narration: 进新实验室，先找到每件安全设施。
overlay: 进门先认清安全设施在哪

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、急救箱三个设施
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station, an emergency shower and a first aid kit on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、急救箱。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 灭火器、灭火毯、手动报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a manual fire alarm call point on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、灭火毯、火灾报警按钮。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 紧急断电按钮、总电源闸、应急电话
shots.prompt_en: An emergency power-off button, a main power switch and a wall phone. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急断电按钮、总电源和应急电话。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 安全出口标志和疏散路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign and green evacuation route arrows on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 安全出口和疏散路线，也要走一遍。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校实验室安全设施导览：沿墙依次拍洗眼器、喷淋、灭火器、急救箱（平移中景，无人物）
shots.prompt_en: A walk-through pan across a real lab wall showing an eyewash station, a shower, an extinguisher and a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 在哪、怎么用，都要心里有数。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 阿杰在纸上画实验室安全地图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a lab safety map with equipment and hazard icons on blank paper.
shots.narration: 画一张安全地图，标出设施和危险源。

shots.section_title: 进门先认清安全设施在哪
shots.scene: 阿杰闭着眼伸手摸到洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, eyes closed, reaches out and finds the eyewash station by touch.
shots.narration: 最好闭着眼，也能摸到洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 应急箱按本室配，伸手可及
shots.scene: 应急箱打开：手套、吸附材料、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: An open emergency spill kit with gloves, absorbent pads and goggles inside. No people.
shots.narration: 应急箱要按本实验室来配。
overlay: 应急箱按本室配，伸手可及

shots.section_title: 应急箱按本室配，伸手可及
shots.scene: 生物实验室的应急箱多了消毒剂和锐器工具
shots.prompt_en: A biology lab spill kit also contains disinfectant and tongs for sharps. No people.
shots.narration: 有生物材料，加配消毒和锐器工具。

shots.section_title: 应急箱按本室配，伸手可及
shots.scene: 锁在柜里、埋在杂物下的应急箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit locked in a cabinet and another buried under clutter, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 锁在柜里、埋在杂物下，等于没有。

shots.section_title: 应急箱按本室配，伸手可及
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校实验室墙边应急箱的固定位置，打开展示内部物品（中景，无人物）
shots.prompt_en: A real lab spill kit mounted at a marked spot on the wall, opened to show its contents.
shots.narration: 放在伸手可及处，定期检查补齐。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 有危险物质的实验区就近装有洗眼器和喷淋
shots.prompt_en: A chemical work area with an eyewash station and an emergency shower installed close by. No people.
shots.narration: 有危险物质的地方，就近配置。
overlay: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 一推阀板就出水，松手仍不停
shots.prompt_en: A hand pushes the eyewash valve paddle once; water keeps flowing after the hand lets go. No faces.
shots.narration: 一个动作就出水，松手也不停。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 再操作一次才关水
shots.prompt_en: The hand pushes the paddle back to stop the water. No faces.
shots.narration: 再操作一次，才关上。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 喷淋水量大，一下浇透人形轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A heavy flow from the emergency shower soaks a body outline at once. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋水量大，一下把人浇透。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 洗眼器水流柔和地涌起
shots.prompt_en: Gentle twin streams rise softly from an eyewash bowl. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器水流柔和，能持续出水。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：就近配置，一开就出水
shots.scene: 检查人员对照清单查看标志和位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the shower sign and location against a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 标志醒目，随时可达，按国标配置。

shots.section_title: 设施前和通道保持畅通
shots.scene: 通往喷淋的通道上堆着推车和纸箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cart and boxes block the path to the emergency shower, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 去洗眼器和喷淋的路，不能堵。
overlay: 设施前和通道保持畅通

shots.section_title: 设施前和通道保持畅通
shots.scene: 喷淋下方空旷，地面没有杂物
shots.prompt_en: The floor under the emergency shower is clear and empty. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋下面，也要保持空旷。

shots.section_title: 设施前和通道保持畅通
shots.scene: 洗眼器盆里放着烧杯，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Beakers left in an eyewash bowl, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器上不放东西，伸手就能用。

shots.section_title: 设施前和通道保持畅通
shots.scene: 有人想把灭火器挪走，被王老师拦下
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops someone from moving a fire extinguisher away from its spot.
shots.narration: 也不能随意挪走设施。

shots.section_title: 设施前和通道保持畅通
shots.scene: 阿杰把洗眼器前的纸箱搬开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the boxes away from the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 发现堵了，马上清理并报告。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 液体溅入眼睛，捂眼呼救
shots.prompt_en: A splash hits near a person's eyes; they cover their eyes and call for help. No faces.
shots.narration: 化学品进了眼睛，马上去洗眼器。
overlay: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 同伴扶着他走到洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student guides him to the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 同伴扶到洗眼器，帮忙打开。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 【实拍】推开洗眼器阀板，水流涌起，俯身对准水流（侧面中景，用清水，不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person pushes the eyewash valve paddle; water streams rise and the person bends over the bowl.
shots.narration: 推开阀板，俯身对准水流。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手手指撑开上下眼睑，让水冲进眼睛，转动眼球（侧面近景，用清水，不露全脸）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up from the side: fingers hold the eyelids open in the water streams while the eyes roll.
shots.narration: 手指撑开眼睑，转动眼球冲洗。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 冲洗时摘掉隐形眼镜，不揉眼
shots.prompt_en: A contact lens is removed during rinsing; rubbing the eyes is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 摘掉隐形眼镜，不揉眼。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 计时图标旁持续冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon beside continuous rinsing at the eyewash. No faces.
shots.narration: 持续冲足时间，按本校规定。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入：撑开眼睑，用洗眼器冲
shots.scene: 冲洗后报告负责人，带上化学品信息就医
shots.prompt_en: After rinsing, the person reports to the older man and goes to a clinic with a blank chemical info sheet.
shots.narration: 冲完报告，带上化学品信息就医。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 化学品泼到身上，衣服着火，大声呼救
shots.prompt_en: A chemical splashes onto a person's clothes and a sleeve catches fire; the person shouts for help. No faces.
shots.narration: 化学品泼身上或衣服着火，大声呼救。
overlay: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 冲向最近的紧急喷淋
shots.prompt_en: The person rushes to the nearest emergency shower. No faces.
shots.narration: 立刻冲到最近的喷淋下。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 【实拍】拉下喷淋拉杆，大量清水倾泻而下，人站在水下（中景，用清水，示范者穿实验服不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person pulls down the shower handle and stands under the heavy flow of clean water.
shots.narration: 拉下拉杆，站在水下冲。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 水量很大的示意，人被浇透
shots.prompt_en: A strong cascade of water drenches a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 水量很大，心里要有准备。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 边冲洗边脱去污染的衣物
shots.prompt_en: A person under the shower removes a soaked contaminated lab coat. No faces.
shots.narration: 边冲洗，边脱去污染衣物。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 同伴拿来干净衣物和遮挡帘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brings clean clothes and holds up a privacy screen.
shots.narration: 同伴帮忙遮挡，拿来干净衣物。

shots.section_title: 身上沾染：拉下喷淋，边冲边脱
shots.scene: 水槽冲不干净时，转用喷淋
shots.prompt_en: A small splash on an arm is rinsed at a sink; a larger one sends the person to the shower. No faces.
shots.narration: 小面积用水槽，冲不掉就用喷淋。

shots.section_title: 便携洗眼器、洗眼瓶只能临时用
shots.scene: 便携式洗眼器水量小，冲一下后奔向固定洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A portable eyewash unit gives a small flow; the person then hurries to a plumbed eyewash. No faces.
shots.narration: 便携洗眼器水量不够，先冲再换。
overlay: 便携洗眼器、洗眼瓶只能临时用

shots.section_title: 便携洗眼器、洗眼瓶只能临时用
shots.scene: 单手按住的软管喷头，腾不出手撑眼，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand-held hose that must be held down leaves no free hand to hold eyelids open, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 要一直按住的软管，不能当洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 便携洗眼器、洗眼瓶只能临时用
shots.scene: 小洗眼瓶冲一下，马上去有水的地方
shots.prompt_en: A small eyewash bottle gives a quick rinse, then the person goes to a running water source. No faces.
shots.narration: 洗眼瓶别无他法才用，用完接着冲。

shots.section_title: 便携洗眼器、洗眼瓶只能临时用
shots.scene: 固定式洗眼器打勾
shots.prompt_en: A plumbed eyewash station gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 主力还是固定式洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好
shots.scene: 喷淋下没有围堰，用吸附条围住废水
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent socks are laid around the shower area to contain the runoff water. No faces.
shots.narration: 没有围堰，用吸附条围住废水。
overlay: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好

shots.section_title: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好
shots.scene: 冲淋废水收集进危险废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Contaminated runoff water is collected into a hazardous waste drum. No people.
shots.narration: 废水不随便处理，按危废收集。

shots.section_title: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好
shots.scene: 放射性标志旁的废水另行处置
shots.prompt_en: Runoff near a radiation trefoil sign is handled under special rules. No people.
shots.narration: 涉及放射性，按专门规定处置。

shots.section_title: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好
shots.scene: 地漏通向下水道的示意，报告图标
shots.prompt_en: A floor drain with an arrow leading to the sewer, next to a report icon. No people.
shots.narration: 弄清地漏通向哪，通下水道要报告。

shots.section_title: 冲淋废水和地漏要管好
shots.scene: 存水弯里有水，挡住下水道气体
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a drain trap filled with water blocking sewer gas from rising. No people.
shots.narration: 存水弯保持有水，挡住下水道气体。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 水管里的存水变脏、积了沉积物的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a pipe with stagnant, cloudy water and sediment. No people.
shots.narration: 水管里的水停久了，会变脏。
overlay: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 【实拍】洗眼器放水测试：打开阀板，观察出水是否及时、柔和、清澈（中景，用清水）
shots.prompt_en: A person tests an eyewash station: opens the valve and watches for prompt, gentle, clear flow.
shots.narration: 定期放水，看出水是否及时清澈。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 喷淋放水测试，水接进水桶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the emergency shower, catching the flow in a large bucket.
shots.narration: 喷淋也一样，定期放水测试。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 日历上标出定期放水日
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with regular flushing days marked with water drop icons. No text.
shots.narration: 多久放一次，按标准和学校规定。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 【实拍】在洗眼器检查卡上填写日期并签名（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand filling in the date and signing an inspection tag hanging on the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 检查卡写上日期，签名。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 出水异常，挂上停用牌并报修
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash with weak, rusty water gets an out-of-service tag and a repair call. No people.
shots.narration: 出水异常，挂牌提醒，及时报修。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 灭火器压力表指针在绿区，查看有效期
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher pressure gauge needle in the green zone and an inspection tag. No text.
shots.narration: 灭火器看压力、查有效期。

shots.section_title: 定期放水检查，登记挂牌
shots.scene: 王老师检查记录本，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews an inspection log and ticks it.
shots.narration: 安全检查都会查，记录要存档。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 嵌在墙里的喷淋洗眼柜，下方只有排水口
shots.prompt_en: A wall-recessed shower and eyewash cabinet with only a drain opening below and no bowl. No people.
shots.narration: 嵌墙式洗眼柜，下面只有排水口。
overlay: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 备好引流软管、接头、专用水桶、螺丝刀和纸巾
shots.prompt_en: A drain hose, a flexible coupling, a dedicated bucket, a flat screwdriver and paper towels laid out. No text.
shots.narration: 先备好软管、接头、专用水桶。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 【实拍】把柔性接头套上排水口，用螺丝刀拧紧卡箍，软管接进水桶（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a flexible coupling fitted over the drain outlet, the clamp tightened with a screwdriver, the hose led into a bucket.
shots.narration: 接头套上排水口，拧紧卡箍。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 【实拍】水桶放稳后启动放水，水经软管流进水桶（中景）
shots.prompt_en: With the bucket set level, the eyewash is activated and water flows through the hose into the bucket.
shots.narration: 水桶放稳，再启动放水。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 关水后等几分钟，水排净再拆
shots.prompt_en: After shutting the water off, a clock icon shows waiting until the hose drains completely. No people.
shots.narration: 关水后等水排净，再拆接头。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜怎样放水
shots.scene: 纸巾接住滴水，擦干地面，水倒进水槽
shots.prompt_en: Paper towels catch drips, the floor is wiped dry, and the bucket is emptied into a sink. No faces.
shots.narration: 接住滴水擦干地面，水倒进水槽。

shots.section_title: 跟老师演练，亲手试过
shots.scene: 王老师带学生演练洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads students in an eyewash drill.
shots.narration: 请老师或安全员带你演练。

shots.section_title: 跟老师演练，亲手试过
shots.scene: 学生亲手拉一次喷淋，惊讶于水量
shots.prompt_en: A student pulls a training shower handle and is surprised by the heavy flow.
shots.narration: 亲手试过一次，才知道真用时的样子。

shots.section_title: 跟老师演练，亲手试过
shots.scene: 灭火毯一拉就出，盖住小火的演示
shots.prompt_en: A fire blanket is pulled from its pouch and laid over a small tray fire in a drill.
shots.narration: 灭火毯一拉就出，灭火器在演练中学。

shots.section_title: 跟老师演练，亲手试过
shots.scene: 全组人员参加应急演练
shots.prompt_en: The whole lab group takes part in an emergency drill.
shots.narration: 人人练过一遍，遇事才不慌。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 平面图上的设施位置和畅通的通道依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Equipment locations on a floor plan and a clear path get green checks one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 认清位置，保持通道畅通。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 洗眼、喷淋、检查卡依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash, an emergency shower and an inspection tag get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 会冲会用，定期放水登记。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着扫把，站在整洁的实验台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a broom beside a tidy lab bench and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲内务整洁与防滑倒。
